name: Web roles (Power Pages)
short_description: Web roles in Microsoft Power Pages are sets of permissions assigned to site users, such as authenticated or anonymous users, that control access to site pages and, together with table permissions, to Dataverse data.

evidence.quote: Their permissions were managed through a separate layer called web roles.
the logged-in contact record and the web roles assigned to that contact are the source of tenant context
a permissions model called web roles and table permissions
